article.h2: Subject: Q4 Dedicated Freight Corridor Renewal (Ref: NWL-2026-Q4-089)
article.p: Thank you for partnering with Northwind Logistics, Inc. across the 2026 shipping cycle. During the past twelve months, our Pacific-Midwest intermodal corridor achieved a 99.4% on-time arrival rate across 1,420 dispatched loads while reducing per-pallet transit damage below 0.08%.
To lock in priority winter capacity before the November 18 scheduling freeze, please review and countersign the enclosed renewal package:

ul.li: Schedule A: Dedicated Lane Rate Card (Seattle to Detroit, Q1-Q4 2027)
Schedule B: Fuel Surcharge Index Cap and SLA Credit Matrix
Schedule C: Cold-Chain Telemetry Compliance Addendum

article.p: Please return the signed schedules by November 15, 2026. Our operations desk remains at your disposal for any routing adjustments.

p.em: Director of Enterprise Accounts, Northwind Logistics, Inc.
